---
title: "Arrow IPC"
---

{{< include ../_setup.qmd >}}

Files ending in `.arrow`, `.ipc`, or `.feather` are read with
[arrow](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/r/). Write Arrow IPC output with
`-O arrow` or by naming the output accordingly.

## Reading

```{bash}
rush run -o flights.arrow 'df' flights.parquet
rush run 'head(df, 3) |> dplyr::select(carrier, origin, dest)' flights.arrow
```

## Writing

```{bash}
rush run -o subset.arrow 'dplyr::filter(df, dep_delay > 10)' flights.parquet
rush run 'nrow(df)' subset.arrow
```

## Using `-O arrow` with output flag

```{bash}
rush run -O arrow -o sample.arrow 'head(df, 5)' penguins.csv
rush run 'ncol(df)' sample.arrow
```

## Alternative extensions

The `.feather` and `.ipc` extensions are also recognized:

```{bash}
cp flights.arrow flights.feather
rush run 'nrow(df)' flights.feather
cp flights.arrow flights.ipc
rush run 'nrow(df)' flights.ipc
rm -f flights.feather flights.ipc
```

```{bash}
#| include: false
rm -f flights.arrow subset.arrow sample.arrow
```
